title: Introduce General Tutorial Player and Recorder Mechanism
description: Introduce a general tutorial mechanism: Rust-first TutorialDefinition core data model (multi-track timeline: narration/voiceover with TTS+optional audio, timed video overlays, annotational events, UI-state keyframes+deltas, invertible vcs document track, camera keyframes, gesture cues reusing IntroductionGesture/IntroductionPoint), a tutorial player and recorder with full parity in both the React shell and the wgpu shell, a new navbar timeline/controls row when a tutorial is active, and a first demo tutorial for the aggregator mirroring its existing 12-step German introduction tour. Zero per-app work required for any app to support tutorials. Full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/introduce-a-general-tutorial-cheerful-lemur.md.
summary:
Implemented the general Tutorial mechanism end-to-end: a recorded, timed, replayable walkthrough with voiceover, an event timeline, video overlay, and full UI/document/command/camera tracking — the timeline sibling of the existing step-gated Introduction mechanism.

Core (framework/core/rs/lib.rs, new //#region 🔖Tutorial): TutorialDefinition and its full multi-track model (narration with TTS+optional audio, video overlay cues, annotational events, UI-state keyframes+deltas via a renderer-neutral TutorialUiSnapshot, an invertible vcs-vocabulary document track, camera keyframes with log-space-zoom/ease-in-out interpolation, gesture cues reusing IntroductionGesture/IntroductionPoint), plus pure engine fns (validate_tutorial, interpolate_tutorial_camera, tutorial_camera_at, compose_tutorial_ui, tutorial_slice) and the startTutorial/recordTutorial action ids. 16 new unit tests, all passing (102/102 crate total).

Plugin SDK (framework/plugin/rs/lib.rs): AppBuilder.tutorial() + validation (refactored the introduction's element-id validator into a shared helper) + auto-injection of startTutorial (when declared)/recordTutorial (always). 9 new tests.

React shell (ui/js/react/index.tsx + framework/renderer/react/index.tsx): TutorialBar navbar row (play/pause/stop/scrubber/chapters/rate/mute/captions/record), TutorialClock, TutorialCaptions, TutorialVideoOverlay, TutorialGhostPointer, a camera-driver registry, TS ports of every core engine fn, a ShellState.tutorial slice with sandboxed start/stop, seek/rebuild, deviation-detection + 600ms converge-tween resume, and a TutorialRecorder (events+UI+camera+document-capable; webcam/mic capture explicitly scoped out). New unit tests added; existing suites still green (435/448 and 269/272, all failures pre-existing/unrelated).

wgpu shell (framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs): full parity — ShellState.tutorial runtime, chrome layout shift, render_tutorial_bar, tick/seek/deviation-converge, a minimal recorder, and a ghost-cursor gesture overlay (Scene/Canvas/Entity/Curve/Domain point kinds and webcam capture explicitly scoped out, documented inline). 15 new tests; 281/281 passing.

Aggregator demo (mit-bestand/aggregator/brand.ts): a ~4-minute, 12-chapter German ENTWERFEN_MIT_BESTAND_TUTORIAL mirroring the existing introduction tour's narration/gestures/element ids, hand-authored with the document track intentionally empty pending a future recorder pass (documented).

Verification: cargo test green across semio-framework-core (102/102), semio-framework-plugin (isolated — crate's own test-compile is blocked by an unrelated concurrent DSL-engine migration elsewhere in the same file, confirmed zero errors in my code by line-location), semio-framework-renderer-wgpu (281/281); bun/vitest green across ui/js/react (435/448, 13 pre-existing unrelated failures) and framework/renderer/react (269/272, 3 pre-existing unrelated failures); zero "tutorial"-referencing TS errors across all four touched TS/TSX files. TS mirror for the new Rust types is hand-written in framework/core/js/index.ts (typegen is blocked workspace-wide by an unrelated `IconName: TS` gap in ui_wgpu from concurrent work) with an explicit TODO to swap to generated types once unblocked.

Live browser e2e was attempted against the aggregator dev server but is currently blocked: rebuilding the puzzle plugin's wasm (needed to pick up the Rust-side tutorials data) fails because a concurrent, in-progress DSL-engine migration added a `vcs::DocumentDsl` supertrait bound to `DocumentApp::Projection` that puzzle/plugin/rs's own `Projection = Value` hasn't been migrated to satisfy yet — confirmed via `git diff` that this bound is not part of my changes. This is pre-existing/external to this ticket and blocks ANY wasm rebuild of the aggregator right now, not just this feature. The React shell chrome itself was confirmed booting correctly against the (stale) already-running dev server (introduction tour rendered and dismissed correctly), demonstrating the shell scaffolding is sound; full click-through of the new TutorialBar/playback against live wasm data should be re-verified once the concurrent DocumentDsl migration completes.
